project: SortVision - waste recognition by material (plastic, paper, glass, metal)
scope: Request-level checks only: values supplied in the request are checked. The photo file is not opened or decoded by this validator.

rules.why: Without a photo reference there is nothing to classify. Means the field is non-empty, not that the file was found.
TrashNet training photos and the tray camera produce JPEG; the baseline was never fitted on other formats.
Interface requirement from Lab 02/04: the baseline was trained only on 512x384 photos and the Lab 04 check_input already rejects any other size.

Lab 03 narrowed the operating conditions to one item on a plain tray under a fixed camera. A photo from another source (e.g. a phone) is readable but outside the conditions the model was evaluated in, so a person checks it.
The runtime preprocessing id is defined in src/inference_demo.py, never taken from the request. It must equal the contract, otherwise the features would not match what baseline-v1 was trained on.
